thread:
kevin: FYI Northbridge (HW partner) asked for an "observability bundle" for their appliance listing. They want Datadog APM + OTLP on-prem forwarding, but are very concerned about retention costs and PII leaving the box.

nina: Good prompt. Two quick asks from product: (1) a short customer-facing one-pager explaining what stays on-prem vs what gets sent to Datadog, and (2) a recommended sampling & retention default for the marketplace tile.

ash: Suggested defaults: traces sampled at 1% overall, but 100% for error spans and traces tagged with customer.support_ticket. Metrics keep 30d standard/13mo rollup for infra, 7d for high-cardinality request metrics unless they opt in.

sam: How do we guarantee no PII leaks? We should provide a collector rewrite/processor example that strips headers and masks user input fields before export.

kevin: Agreed. Also include an example of using the external_agent forwarding pattern (collector -> datadog) vs direct OTLP exporter from the service. We should recommend collector-side forwarding for appliances.

nina: I'll draft the one-pager language. Keep it simple: "Telemetry stays local; only sanitized, sampled traces and metrics push to Datadog for monitoring and dashboards." Also highlight the self-hosted collector approach.

ash: Collector processors example we can ship in the README:
```yaml
processors:
  batch:
  attributes/transform:
    actions:
      - key: http.request.body
        action: delete
      - key: user.email
        action: delete
exporters:
  datadog:
    apikey: "<DATADOG_APIKEY_PLACEHOLDER>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [attributes/transform, batch]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

sam: For masking free-form text (prompts), add a redaction step in the instrumentation best-practice: do not record full prompt text as a span attribute; instead use prompt.hash and prompt.length. Add example snippet for Python: `span.set_attribute("prompt.hash", sha256(prompt))`

kevin: Nice. Also include a short troubleshooting checklist for customers: collector status, `otelcol` logs, datadog-agent status, port 4317 open, firewall rules, and a quick cURL test to the local endpoint.

ops-bot: task: create marketplace tile PR assigned to nina - due 3 days

nina: Timeline proposal:
- Today: Nina draft one-pager + legal check note
- Tue: Ash publishes collector config examples + masking processor
- Wed: Sam publishes instrumentation guidance (prompt hashing + schema)
- Thu: Kevin prepares demo harness + dashboard JSON for Datadog
- Fri: Joint dry run with Northbridge marketing (15m)

ash: For the demo harness, I'll simulate 5 customers by tagging traces with `tenant.id`. We'll show a per-tenant dashboard and a cross-tenant health overview. Need to expose `model.version` and `model.hash` as tags.

sam: Do we want to surface per-token metrics to Datadog or keep tokens internal? Token metrics are high-cardinality and can be expensive. Recommend counters for token.rate aggregated by model.id and daily rollups only.

kevin: Recommend metric plan: per-tenant request.count, request.error.count, request.latency.p50/p95. Token_rate as aggregated metric: `tokens.sum` with tags [model.id], sample period 1m. No free-text tag values.

nina: Legal note: no Northbridge logos in the marketplace tile until we have signed co-marketing. I'll add that to the PR checklist.

ash: For Datadog dashboard template, include:
- Top row: overall QPS, error rate, avg latency
- Middle: GPU utilization, mem, power draw (if available via hw exporter)
- Bottom: trace flamegraph focusing on span durations for model inferece and kernel queue time

sam: Also add an alert template: high tail latency (>500ms p95 for 3m), sustained GPU temp >80C for 5m, sudden uptick in trace error rate >2% over baseline.

kevin: Canary plan: ash runs the harness in our staging and we verify traces show up in a datadog staging org using the placeholder key. Confirm mapping of `model.version` attribute -> datadog tag `model_version`.

ops-bot: deploy: observability-harness v0.2 deployed to staging (tag: northbridge-demo-2026-03-22)

nina: We'll need a short GIF (30s) for the marketplace tile showing dashboard update and tenant selector. Ash, can you record?

ash: Yes. I'll capture the tenant selector switching and a trace drilldown showing an error span.

sam: One operational caveat: recommend retention & sampling be adjustable via appliance UI. Customer should be able to raise sampling for an incident window to 100% for a tenant for 1 hour. Add API snippet to change sampling rate in collector config via SSM/agent hook.

kevin: Add a troubleshooting entry: If traces not appearing, run `otelcol --config /etc/otel/config.yaml --log-level debug` and `datadog-agent status` and check the exporter connection string.

nina: I'll put all deliverables into a single PR and ping partners channel when ready. Thanks team :thumbsup:
